description: A root-managed systemd unit file is world-writable; lowpriv rewrites ExecStart and triggers a sudo-permitted restart to execute arbitrary commands as root.
detailed_description: /etc/systemd/system/maintenance.service has mode 666, and sudoers grants lowpriv NOPASSWD on `systemctl restart maintenance.service` and `systemctl daemon-reload`. An attacker rewrites ExecStart to drop a SUID shell, then triggers the restart. systemd (pid 1) executes the new ExecStart as root.
